observations: Red metal gas cylinder lying in a car trunk.
Significant surface rust and paint chipping across the body.
A gas regulator is attached to the top valve.
No visible manufacturer stamps, weight markings, or expiry dates.
The cylinder appears larger than a standard 6kg but its exact scale is difficult to determine from this angle.

claims.evidence: No weight markings are visible on the cylinder collar or body in photo 0.
The origin of the item cannot be confirmed from a visual inspection of a used cylinder.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped date on the collar or stay plate.
A photo of the stamped weight (TW or kg) on the collar.
A video showing a soapy water leak test while the cylinder is under pressure.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the stamped markings on the collar (handle area) showing weight and date.
Photo of the cylinder standing upright next to a known object for scale.
Close-up of the valve connection point without the regulator.
response.reason: The item is clearly a gas cylinder, but without visible stamps for capacity or expiry, it must be priced at its worst case as an expired 12.5kg unit.
